brief_bullets: Jay Rockefeller, the influential former West Virginia governor and five-term U.S. senator, has passed away at age 89. A prominent member of the storied Rockefeller family, he notably broke from his dynasty’s Republican roots to champion Democratic policies, most significantly the creation of the Children’s Health Insurance Program, which expanded coverage to millions of low-income youth. During his thirty-year tenure in the Senate, Rockefeller became a pivotal figure in healthcare reform and intelligence oversight, leaving a legacy defined by his commitment to public service and social welfare. His death marks the end of an era for a political titan who leveraged his immense private wealth to advocate for systemic improvements in American public health and government accountability.
why_it_matters_bullets: His passing marks the loss of a rare bipartisan bridge-builder whose legislative legacy fundamentally reshaped American pediatric healthcare access.

stories.primary_headline: CBSE announces date sheet for class 10 and 12 board examinations 2027

primary_source.headline: CBSE announces date sheet for class 10 and 12 board examinations 2027
primary_source.content: New Delhi: After a delay, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) finally announced the dates for class 10 and 12 examinations. Exams for both the classes will begin on February 16, with physics being the first paper for Class 12 and painting the first for Class 10. The exams will conclude on March 9 for Class 10 and April 9 for Class 12.The exams, which will be held offline in pen-paper model, will be conducted across 86 subjects for Class 10, and for Class 12, students will appear across 121 subjects.CBSE Board Exams 2027: Practical exams from January 1; Class 10, 12 date sheet awaited“Adequate gaps have been provided between examinations of subjects commonly offered together by students in both Class X and Class XII. The tentative schedules of major entrance examinations for Class XII students have been taken  into account. Every effort has been made to complete the Board Examinations well before the commencement of such entrance examinations, enabling students to manage their preparation effectively,” CBSE said in a release. The board also said that it has further taken into account the number of candidates appearing on a particular day at each examination centre to facilitate smooth conduct of examinations. They added that the schedule was designed to minimise the prolonged absence of teachers from their schools during the evaluation process.In all, the Board said, it factored in 40,000 subject combinations while designing the exam sheet.

The case garnered substantial public scrutiny following reports that Sajeev dismissively questioned the purpose of roads immediately after the collision. By balancing the defendant's rights with the necessity of a thorough investigation, the court’s decision underscores the judicial focus on rehabilitation for first-time offenders while maintaining the integrity of ongoing legal proceedings regarding reckless driving and public safety. The ruling highlights judicial discretion in balancing public outrage against legal precedents for youthful, first-time offenders in traffic cases.

brief_bullets: Nationalist Congress Party leader Praful Patel recently visited Sharad Pawar at a hospital, igniting intense speculation regarding a potential reconciliation between the fractured NCP factions. While state president Sunil Tatkare suggested that a reunification would have been inevitable had the political landscape remained static, NCP-SP MLA Rohit Pawar dismissed these rumors as deliberate misinformation spread by disgruntled elements seeking to advance personal agendas. Sharad Pawar, a veteran figure known for his unpredictable political maneuvers, remains at the center of this discourse as observers analyze whether this meeting signals a genuine shift in Maharashtra’s volatile coalition dynamics or merely a social gesture. The incident underscores the persistent instability and strategic maneuvering defining the state's complex political environment.
why_it_matters_bullets: This meeting highlights the ongoing volatility in Maharashtra's coalition politics and the strategic uncertainty surrounding NCP's future alignment.

Tamil Nadu DVAC books DMK general secretary Durai Murugan in illegal sand mining scam
Operation Deep Source: Tamil Nadu Police Bust Inter-State Drugs Syndicate

brief_bullets: School Education Minister Raj Mohan said on Friday that an inquiry has begun: "Whoever is involved will be brought before the law, and justice will be ensured." Chennai: In yet another setback to the DMK, the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) on Friday registered a case against party General Secretary and former Water Resources Minister Durai Murugan in connection with an alleged Rs 1,427 crore illegal sand mining scam, flagged by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) in 2024.

The case was registered against Murugan, next only to party chief M K Stalin in the DMK, retired Chief Engineers A Muthiya, Ramamoorthy, 14 public servants of the Water Resources Department and 10 private individuals and firms.
why_it_matters_bullets: Triggers heightened municipal security deployments and intensifies scrutiny over public safety and emergency protocols.
